outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic with accompanying western blot images (IP validation), not a plot of averaged data.

Bar charts show single densitometry-derived quantification values (% FT depletion, log2 elution abundance) per antibody with no error bars or stated replicate number, so these are not presented as averages requiring individual point overlay.
Heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Violin plots showing distribution of enrichment ratios; violin plots inherently display the data distribution and are exempt.
Bar chart explicitly reports mean ± SD (n = 4) and overlays individual replicate values as circular data points on each bar.
Panel F is a sequence alignment together with a predicted 3D structure model, not a data plot.
Scatterplots comparing enrichment ratios; scatterplots are exempt since the individual points are themselves the data.
Scatterplot of HTT vs HAP40 abundance across individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt from the requirement.
PCA scatterplot of individual samples; scatterplots are exempt from the requirement.
PCA scatterplots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum) of individual samples; scatterplots are exempt from the requirement.
